meta.name: ai-sdk-core
meta.description:
Build backend AI with Vercel AI SDK v6 stable. Covers Output API (replaces generateObject/streamObject), speech synthesis, transcription, embeddings, MCP tools with security guidance. Includes v4→v5 migration and 15 error solutions with workarounds.

Use when: implementing AI SDK v5/v6, migrating versions, troubleshooting AI_APICallError, Workers startup issues, Output API errors, Gemini caching issues, Anthropic tool errors, MCP tools, or stream resumption failures.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能使用 Vercel AI SDK v6 构建后端 AI 应用，包括文本生成、结构化输出、语音合成、转录、嵌入、图像生成、MCP 工具等，并支持 v4→v5 迁移和 15 种错误解决方案。
howto.when: 当你要求实现 AI SDK v5/v6 功能、迁移版本、或排查 AI_APICallError、Workers 启动问题、Output API 错误、Gemini 缓存问题、Anthropic 工具错误、MCP 工具或流恢复失败时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can build backend AI applications using Vercel AI SDK v6, including text generation, structured output, speech synthesis, transcription, embeddings, image generation, MCP tools, and supports v4→v5 migration and 15 error solutions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement AI SDK v5/v6 features, migrate versions, or troubleshoot AI_APICallError, Workers startup issues, Output API errors, Gemini caching issues, Anthropic tool errors, MCP tools, or stream resumption failures.
